t: The Irrepressible Outlier: Finding Originality in a World of Infinite Content
s: The article traces the evolution of digital information from early gaming consoles to AI, highlighting how technological sparks ignite chain reactions. It posits that content is becoming functionally infinite due to AI, posing challenges for discovery and prompting a need to design websites for AI's dual crawling needs: training and RAG.
sub: Evolution of Digital Literacy (Printing Press -> Digital -> AI)
The Great Tech Tug-of-War (Atari vs. Commodore, Jay Miner's influence)
